comment: Bundled substitutes for document fonts, each family with its licence file. Arimo, Tinos, Cousine, Gelasio and Selawik are the upstream WOFF2 files unchanged; Carlito and Caladea are published upstream only as TTF and were compressed to WOFF2 here (see each face's conversion). Apps serve or read the files by their path here and must ship each family's licence file with them. Regenerate src/core/fonts/tables.generated.ts with `pnpm run generate:fonts` after any change. Each family's "pdf" faces are TrueType files for PDF embedding, gzip-compressed and fetched only when a PDF is exported (upstream TTFs, or static instances of the variable fonts); "fallbacks" are Noto families fetched only when exported text is in a script, or uses symbols or math operators, the bundled families lack. Regenerate src/core/pdfwrite/fonts/faces.generated.ts with `pnpm run generate:pdf-fonts` after any change to those.

upstream.conversion: Compressed to WOFF2 with fontTools 4.60.1 (brotli 1.1.0) without WOFF metadata or private data. Every table decompresses to the upstream bytes (glyf/loca glyph for glyph); in head only checkSumAdjustment and the flags bit 11 that WOFF2 sets differ. Original font data unchanged except for WOFF compression, so not a Modified Version under OFL FAQ 2.2.1 and the Reserved Font Name stays.

metricSources.use: Vertical metrics of the fonts the project matches for document layout; read at generation time, not shipped

metricSources.name: Chrome OS extra fonts Carlito
metricSources.use: Vertical metrics of Carlito as first published, the build LibreOffice ships: its hhea, typo and win values are Calibri's (the bundled upstream build moved hhea to the win values); read at generation time, not shipped

measuredLineMetrics.font: Georgia Regular, Bold, Italic and Bold Italic
measuredLineMetrics.use: Vertical metrics only, read once from the tables named here and identical in all four styles; no font data is read at generation time or shipped

calibratedLineMetrics.evidence: Line height fitted to Word's recorded page breaks in 25 public Word documents of the test corpus using the family (68 breaks, ground truth consistent with the documents' page references): on the same line 51.5 % with the substitute's own metrics, 67.6 % fitted, 55.9 % held out (each file scored with the values fitted on the others); never measured from the font.

Line height fitted to Word's recorded page breaks in 10 public Word documents of the test corpus using the family (41 breaks, ground truth consistent with the documents' page references): on the same line 12.2 % with the substitute's own metrics, 43.9 % fitted, 17.1 % held out (each file scored with the values fitted on the others); never measured from the font. Drawn with Arimo at the fitted size 1.01 (CALIBRATED_TAHOMA_SCALE).
